_note: The upstream's own response body, passed through untouched — this solution adds identity and correlation, not transformation. The array below is illustrative for an Orders API.
_headers_required: X-Request-Id — must be present and non-empty
_capture_this: Note the X-Request-Id value. It is the input to the correlation-end-to-end case, which checks the SAME id appears in your backend's logs. Presence at the gateway is half a feature; the other half is your teams recording the forwarded header.
_in_analytics: One row, carrying: route /orders (templated where applicable), the calling app and developer by name, status 200, latency, and this request id. Three of those six fields exist only because of decisions made on the request path.
